theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Choose between light and dark appearance

language.label: Language
language.description: Select the display language for the application

autoExclude.label: Auto-exclude on deploy
autoExclude.description: Automatically add the file to .git/info/exclude when creating a deployment. If disabled, you can add it manually later from the deployment card.

tags.label: Manage tags
tags.description: View and delete tags. Tags in use by files will remain assigned until removed manually.

appData.label: Application data
appData.description: Location where the application stores its database and file versions
appData.cloudSyncWarning: This location is inside a cloud-synced folder (Synology Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud, Google Drive). The sync client modifies the database files while the application is using them, which causes intermittent "disk I/O error" failures when creating deployments, commits or snapshots. Move the data to a local folder.

changeDialog.title: Change data location
changeDialog.modeKeepHint: Use the data already present at this location
changeDialog.modeTransferHint: Copy your current database and files to this location
changeDialog.modeFreshHint: Begin with an empty database and no files
changeDialog.existingDataDetected: Existing application data detected at this location
changeDialog.restartWarning: The application will restart to apply the change

snapshots.label: Automatic snapshots
snapshots.description: Automatically save a snapshot every time a managed file changes. Snapshots are saved between commits and can be browsed in the history timeline.

logs.label: Application log
logs.description: See what the application is doing internally: git operations, deployments and any error, with its real cause.
logs.title: Application log
logs.verboseHint: Also record every internal operation (debug level). Useful to reproduce a problem; makes the log grow faster.
logs.limitHint: How many entries to read from the end of the log file

export.label: Export data
export.description: Export all application data to a backup file
export.error: An error occurred while exporting data

import.label: Import data
import.description: Import application data from a backup file
import.error: An error occurred while importing data
import.confirm: Are you sure you want to import this data? Existing data will be replaced.

update.checkError: Could not check for updates. Click to retry.
update.readyHint: Downloaded and verified. The app will close and open again with the new version.
update.installing: Installing. The app will open again.
update.installFailed: The last installation did not finish and you are still on the previous version. If macOS blocked it, allow SincroGitExclude in System Settings > Privacy & Security > App Management.

blocked.translocated: To update from here, move the app to the Applications folder and open it again.
blocked.disk-image: To update from here, copy the app to the Applications folder.
blocked.not-writable: There is no permission to replace the app. Download it and install it by hand.

channel.label: Channel
channel.betaHint: Release candidates before they go stable.
channel.devHint: Test builds published from a pull request. May be unstable.

notice.title: There is a new version: {{version}}
notice.snoozeHint: Later: you will be reminded in a day.
notice.dismissHint: Dismiss: no more notices about this version. It stays in Settings.

webServer.label: Web access
webServer.description: Serve the application over HTTP so you can use it from a browser on another machine. Everything runs on this computer; the browser is only the interface.
webServer.bindAll: Allow access from other machines on the network
webServer.networkWarning: The server accepts connections from the network. Anyone with the token can read and write files and run git on this machine — use it only on networks you trust, or over a VPN.
webServer.tokenHint: Enter this token the first time you open the address in a browser. You can also type your own: at least {{min}} characters, no spaces. Changing or regenerating it signs out every open session.
webServer.tokenInvalid: The token must be between {{min}} and {{max}} characters, with no spaces.
webServer.copyError: Could not copy to the clipboard. Select the text and copy it manually.
webServer.desktopOnly: The server can only be started, stopped or reconfigured from the desktop window: doing it from here would cut off your own connection.

sync.label: Remote sync
sync.description: Push and pull every managed file, its history and its metadata to a single git repository (GitHub, GitLab, a bare repo on a NAS...). Each file lives in its own sge/files/<id>/* branches, so the remote does not mix with anything else. Deployments belong to each machine: they are shared as sources for new deployments, never applied on their own.
sync.remoteHint: Uses this computer's git credentials (SSH or a credential helper); the app stores no passwords or tokens. A private, empty repository dedicated to this is recommended.
sync.testOk: Connection OK. The remote has {{files}} synced file(s).
sync.pushSummary: Push finished: {{pushed}} file(s) with changes, {{upToDate}} already up to date.
sync.pullSummary: Pull finished: {{created}} new file(s), {{updated}} updated, {{fastForwarded}} branch(es) fast-forwarded.
sync.issueDeleted: {{name}} was deleted on another machine. It is kept here; delete it manually if you no longer need it.

mcp.label: MCP access for AI assistants
mcp.description: Lets AI assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot...) use the app: list and create files, deploy, review changes, commit, restore versions, sync and change settings. Works while the app is open.
mcp.readOnlyHint: The assistant can look at everything but change nothing: write tools are not even listed.
mcp.bindAll: Allow connections from other machines on the network
mcp.networkWarning: Anyone on the network with the token will be able to read and change your managed files and run git on this computer. Traffic is not encrypted (HTTP): use it only on trusted networks or over a VPN.
mcp.regenerateConfirm: Clients already set up will stop connecting until you copy the command again. Regenerate the token?
mcp.connectHint: Pick your assistant and copy the command or the configuration. The URL and token are already in it.
mcp.genericConfig: Connection details for any MCP client with HTTP (Streamable HTTP)
mcp.notRunningHint: The server is stopped: start it so the client can connect.

notes.merge: If the file already exists, add this entry to the ones it has instead of replacing it.
notes.nodeRequired: Claude Desktop only accepts local servers over stdio, so this uses the mcp-remote bridge, which needs Node.js installed. Restart Claude Desktop after saving.
notes.antigravity: Since June 2026, Gemini CLI was replaced by Antigravity CLI for free and Google One accounts.

mcp.preventSleep: Keep this computer awake while the MCP is open to the network
mcp.preventSleepHint: So other computers can use the knowledge base even when nobody uses this one.

tokens.title: Per-device tokens
tokens.hint: Create one token per computer or assistant, with only the permissions it needs. You can give access to the memory without access to managed files, and revoke each one separately.
tokens.scopesHint: kb = knowledge base, sge = managed files. read = look, write = change, admin = add and configure spaces (destinations are confirmed on this computer).
tokens.created: Token created. The commands below already use it:
tokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke this token? The computer using it will lose access.
